comment: Golden vectors for runtime-health/v4 Severity, Heartbeat Mapping, Request and Representation, and for the gateway-api/v2 runtime node heartbeat degradation_reasons validation as runtime-health/v4 amends it. A 'snapshot' carries only the members the condition table reads; every other member of the payload is out of scope here; a response_cases response is whole. In heartbeat_cases an absent 'degradation_reasons' in 'expected' means the heartbeat omits the field. In request_cases each entry of 'writes_hex' is one client write, delivered in order; 'after' is what the client does once they are sent. In awaiting_receipt_age_cases each envelope lists the custody acknowledgements that verified for it, in the order received, with the key generation that signed each. 'received_at_ms' is when it arrived, which the rule never reads; 'judged_at_ms' is when the runtime verified and judged it, and r is the judged_at_ms of the first agreeing acceptance that has one. Both are null where the runtime kept no record time. A conforming implementation reproduces every 'expected'.
